description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different models in terms of AUC percentage as a function of the number of data points (N). The x-axis, labeled "N," is linear and ranges from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "AUC (%)", is also linear and ranges from 75 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot features five lines, each representing a different model. The blue line starts at an AUC of approximately 95% at N=0, peaks at around 100% at N=5, and then gradually declines to about 95% at N=20. The orange line begins at an AUC of about 90% at N=0, peaks at around 95% at N=5, and then slightly declines to just below 90% at N=20. The green line starts at an AUC of approximately 85% at N=0, peaks at around 90% at N=5, and then slightly declines to about 85% at N=20. The red line begins at an AUC of about 80% at N=0, peaks at around 85% at N=5, and then slightly declines to about 80% at N=20. The purple line starts at an AUC of approximately 80% at N=0, peaks at around 95% at N=5, and then sharply declines to about 80% at N=20.
